verdict.rationale: The evidence shows some employee-facing equity features: Pulley emails holders at each new vesting event, grants go out for acceptance and signature through Pulley, and pricing lists interactive offer letters. None of it documents a dedicated employee portal showing grants, vesting progress, strike price and outcome-based value. The exit-scenario modeling shown is an admin fundraising tool, not an employee view. Missing for 10: documented employee portal/dashboard, display of grants and strike price to the employee, visual vesting-progress tracking, employee-facing equity value scenario modeling, independent or hands-on corroboration.
